title: Magic Quarter
wikitext:
[[Image:Magic Quarter.jpg|thumb|Magic Quarter]]
[[The Magic Quarter]] is located in the northeastern parts of the [[Undercity]]. This is where the most arcane-inclined of the [[Forsaken]] come to research, learn new spells, and practice their arts, under the watchful eye of [[Bethor Iceshard]]. 

Facilities:
* [[Mage]] trainers
* [[Warlock]] and their pets' trainers
* [[Tailoring]] training to [[Expert]] (skill level 225) (inner ring)
* [[Portal]] trainer
